summary: SmartKem filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-50 reverse stock split, authorized by shareholders on June 23, 2026, and effective after market close on August 20, 2026, with trading on a post-split basis beginning August 21, 2026. The split is intended to support continued Nasdaq listing, with proportionate adjustments to equity awards and warrants. Fractional shares will be rounded up to whole shares, preserving ownership percentages uniformly. The press release was included as Exhibit 99.1. The event is a capital structure adjustment, not a special situation; watch for Nasdaq compliance and potential delisting risk.
